# LUVMEX — Custom Software & Product Engineering

> LUVMEX is a premier custom software and product engineering company. We engineer resilient, scalable systems, SaaS platforms, and AI-powered solutions for modern businesses.

## Core Capabilities
- Custom Software Solutions: Scalable, high-concurrency backend architectures and tailored full-stack applications.
- SaaS Products: Multi-tenant platforms with subscription billing, analytics, and cloud-native infrastructure.
- Web Applications: Modern Next.js and React applications optimized for Core Web Vitals and accessibility.
- Mobile Applications: High-performance iOS and Android applications.
- AI-Powered Solutions: Machine learning pipelines, LLM fine-tuning and integrations, and autonomous automation workflows.
- Domain-Specific Solutions: Healthcare (HIPAA), FinTech, E-Commerce, Logistics, EdTech, and PropTech systems.
